contract:
Not forked by viewport; covers phone and desktop. No other area owns these five files.

page.tsx:
- generateMetadata (:66-81): select also hidden_at; hidden -> return { title: 'Vibe' } (no name/description for anyone).
- Org load (:87-93) adds `join_policy, audience, hidden_at, campus_id`. OrgProfile type (:39-54): drop is_public use; add join_policy: JoinPolicy, audience: OrgAudience, hidden: boolean, campus_id: string|null, member_count: number|null, follower_count: number|null.
- Member count (:96-99, :127): `{ count, error }`; error -> member_count null (C27), never `?? 0`.
- Follower count: `loadFollowerCounts(service, [org.id]).get(org.id) ?? null` from src/lib/orgs/following.ts (F1; service client, null on read error).
- Viewer block (:131-156) replaced: signed in -> Promise.all([loadViewerOrgContext(service, org.id, user.id), service.from('org_followers').select('id').eq('org_id', org.id).eq('user_id', user.id).maybeSingle()]); decision = orgJoinState({org:{join_policy, audience, hidden_at, campus_id}, viewer: ctx.viewer, role: ctx.role, pendingInvite: ctx.pendingInvite, pendingRequest: ctx.pendingRequest}). `following = !!ctx.role || !!followRow.data` (a failed follow read renders 'Follow'; POST is idempotent). Inviter name exactly as src/app/api/orgs/[slug]/route.ts:271-283 (visibleInviterFirstName + loadHiddenUsers; failed hidden read -> null).
- Hidden gate: `if (orgRaw.hidden_at && (!user || decision.state === 'not_found')) notFound()`. A platform admin gets state 'hidden'; members get 'member'.
- displayState = user ? decision.state : 'signed_out'. If user && !ctx.ok: render <LoadFailed tone='dark' failure={{message: "Couldn't load your membership. Try again."}} /> in the header slot and pass joinState null to ChannelsSection.
- relation: OrgRelation = {handle, orgName: name, state: displayState, following, role: ctx.role, reason: decision.reason ?? null, audience, joinPolicy: join_policy}.
- Admin bar (:197-204): render when isSettingsOfficer(role) (owner/admin; POST_AS_ORG_ROLES and upload-url are owner/admin, posts/route.ts:34, upload-url/route.ts:99). New props: orgName, joinPolicy, audience, hidden, openToCampus: {name, shared} | null computed with campusRowById(org.campus_id) + isSharedCampus from @/lib/iu/campuses.
- Header slot (:207-215): <OrgProfileJoinButton relation={relation} pendingInviteId={ctx.pendingInvite?.id ?? null} />.
- Chips (:455-461): VerifiedBadge; policyChip(join_policy) with the lock icon for 'By request'/'Invite only'; audienceChip; 'Hidden' when org.hidden (only members/admins reach the page); 'Invited you' when state invited; 'Dormant' unchanged.
- Handle line (:486-488): '@{handle}' then followerCountText(follower_count) then memberCountText(member_count), ' · ' separators only between present parts. Floor 5 applies to every viewer here (officers get the exact number in the desktop Followers tab).
- Above the description, when state invited: <OrgInviteBanner orgName inviterFirstName={invitedByName} expiresAt={ctx.pendingInvite.expires_at} />.
- Notice (:220; PrivateOrgNotice :587-634 renamed JoinPolicyNotice): text = joinPolicyNotice({state, joinPolicy, audience, orgName, hidden}); render nothing on null. Keep the lock glyph; drop the bold 'This community is private.' lead.
- ChannelsSection (:246-249): props {orgHandle, relation (null when ctx failed)}.
- FactsSection (:828-845): rows in order 'Followers' (value String(n), omitted when followerCountText is null), 'Members' (omitted when null), 'Who can join' = whoCanJoinFact, 'Open to' = openToFact, 'Status' (unchanged), 'Last activity' (unchanged). 'Visibility' removed.

join-button.tsx: replace the whole component. `export function OrgProfileJoinButton({ relation, pendingInviteId })` renders <OrgJoinControl variant='header' source='profile' relation pendingInviteId onChange={() => router.refresh()} /> (useRouter from next/navigation). isPublic/initialRole/initialPending props deleted.

ChannelsSection.tsx: props `{ orgHandle: string; relation: OrgRelation | null }`. relation null -> <LoadFailed tone='dark' failure={{message: "Couldn't load this org's channels."}} onRetry={router.refresh} /> with NO fetch. relation.state !== 'member' -> NO fetch (the effect at :51-73 must not run); render the section card with channelsGateCopy(relation).line and, when inline is non-null, <OrgJoinControl variant='header' axis='membership' source='profile' relation onChange={router.refresh} />. Member -> today's behaviour (fetch, groups, '+ Join all public'). Delete the visitor-only branches: 'Join the org above to chat in these channels.' (:238) and the non-member dimming/preventDefault in ChannelRow (:287-320).

admin-actions.tsx (OrgProfileAdminBar :50-146): props add orgName, joinPolicy, audience, hidden, openToCampus. Eyebrow (:98) 'Owner / admin tools' -> 'Officer tools'; when hidden -> 'Hidden org'. Buttons (:65-70): not hidden -> [ 'Invite people' (person-plus icon, FIRST), 'Banner', 'Logo', 'Edit details', 'New post' ]; hidden -> [ 'Edit details' ] only. 'Invite people' opens <OrgInviteSheet handle orgName audience presentation={window.matchMedia('(max-width: 720px)').matches ? 'sheet' : 'modal'} onClose />. EditDetailsModal (:148-245): add Field 'Who can join' (WHO_CAN_JOIN_OPTIONS segmented, label + sub) and Field 'Open to' (openToOptions(openToCampus)) with AUDIENCE_HELP under it and OFFICER_FOLLOW_HELP under both; both fields hidden when org hidden. PATCH body (:172-180) adds join_policy / audience ONLY when changed from the initial values; a non-ok response shows the server `error` string (audience_excludes_owner and org_hidden messages come from the route) in the existing ErrorBanner.

src/app/api/orgs/[slug]/channels/route.ts GET (:21-50) (C18, third orgs_select casualty): after auth, load the org with createSupabaseServiceClient() selecting `id, hidden_at` (not the user client at :29-33); missing -> 404 {ok:false, error:'Not found', code:'not_found'}; service read of org_members role for (org, user); no role -> hidden_at ? 404 not_found : 403 {ok:false, error:'Channels are for members', code:'members_only'}. The channels read (:38-44) stays on the USER client so can_view_org_channel keeps filtering private channels. POST (:59-138) unchanged. Callers that already are members are unaffected (campus-home.tsx:521, :1152; CampusMobile.tsx:1860).
acceptance: npx tsc --noEmit clean; eslint count not above HEAD; `grep -n "is_public\|isPublic" src/app/orgs/[handle]/*.tsx` -> only generateMetadata's description fallback, if kept.

375x812 + 1280 screenshots with in-page overrides of the page's client calls for invited (banner 'You're invited to join SAE', sub 'Invited by Franky · Expires {Mon D}', header 'Accept invite' + 'Decline', chip 'Invited you'), can_join (Follow + Join, channels inline Join), member (Following ✓ disabled + 'Members follow automatically' + Joined ✓, channels list).
